definitions: An exclamation of annoyance, frustration, or sometimes grudging affection towards someone, often a child or a younger person, who is being mischievous, troublesome, or irritating.
Used to describe a person, often a child, who is behaving badly or causing trouble.
examples: Oh, you spilled the milk again, you little shit!
He hid my keys, the little shit!
My nephew just drew on the wall, little shit!
